42: "Ardalyon Borisitch is acting curiously. He would very much like to be an inspector, and it looks to me as if Varvara were leading him by the nose. So he's up to all sorts of tricks."

24: "Well, Marta, you'd better take it," said Vershina. "And thank Vladimir Ivanitch."
